title: NodeWright package metadata
description: The config blob of a v1 NodeWright package artifact (application/vnd.nvidia.nodewright.package.config.v1+json)

uninstall.description: Whether the package supports being uninstalled

config.description: The package's config.json. Its contents are validated by the agent, not here

interrupt.description: How the package senses that it needs an interrupt, and how it runs one

path.description: Path to the executable relative to skyhook_dir: non-empty, no leading or trailing /, and no empty, . or .. segment

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the executable

on_host.description: Run the executable on the host rather than inside the agent
